steps: library: a keeper and a lantern room, both with sheets
scene: keeper and lantern room attached
frames: start and end generated from the scene's library items
provenance: each frame names the library items behind it
take: rendered from an approved estimate
shoot: the clip runs from the start frame to the end frame, and says so
ui: the open scene shows its items, its shots and their frames
ui: a collapsed scene is a single heading row
